kf: Pre-op check: is the procedure **indicated, funded, safe and wanted**?
**Antithrombotics (BSDS 2023)**: usually **continue**; thrombotic harm from stopping outweighs bleeding harm.
Write a clear **antithrombotic plan** (doses to take or omit, restart time).
Post-op analgesia: **paracetamol first**; avoid NSAIDs in anticoagulated patients. Many antibiotics raise INR with warfarin.
Check allergies (latex, chlorhexidine, LA, plasters), pacemakers (diathermy), keloid history, smoking, steroids.
myths: **"Stop aspirin a week before every excision"**: this is usually unnecessary and risky.
patho_lead: Most complications are **predictable from patient factors** checked before surgery.

mech.t: Diabetes, immunosuppression, lower-leg and groin sites.
Smoking, steroids, oedema and the lower leg.
